snippet.title: Sanitarium Massacre GRINDHOUSE Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out my new horror games: http://puppetcombo.com

Designed by Pig Farmer Games: http://pigfarmergames.com
The first video game where you play as a slasher movie serial killer. It's a tribute to 80s horror movies, synth scores and the VHS format. For Windows PCs 

More info: http://pigfarmergames.com/games/sanitarium-massacre/

Narrator: Edward Sacco https://www.facebook.com/ESVOA
